source: TOPIK II — questions from the papers the player brings, plus explicitly requested vocabulary lists
title: TOPIK II

level.name: 토픽 II 준비
level.description: Farm exam vocabulary and your own word lists, and work the questions at the desk.
level.descriptionEn: A practice world for TOPIK II, band 3-4급. Questions arrive one at a time, and the vocabulary grows from those papers and the word lists you explicitly add. Words already taught elsewhere stay here too and share the same learning progress.

vocabularySources.note: Fourteen headwords explicitly supplied by the learner. Example sentences are original practice material, not quotations from an exam paper.

Twenty-one headwords explicitly supplied by the learner. 이상 already existed and is reused; twenty new entries were appended. Example sentences are original practice material, not quotations from an exam paper.
